headerDisplay: Samsung SmartThings devices in Apple Home. Provide either a personal access token or OAuth credentials.

accessToken.title: Personal access token
accessToken.description: Short lived. Prefer the OAuth settings below for a long running install.

finishedHoldMinutes.title: Finished sensor hold (minutes)
finishedHoldMinutes.description: How long the washer and dryer Finished sensor stays triggered after a cycle ends.

connection.title: Connection to Apple Home
connection.description: Auto uses Matter when Matter is switched on for this bridge in Homebridge, otherwise HomeKit. Devices are published over one connection only. TVs are always also published as HomeKit external accessories.

leakAs.title: Moisture sensor as (Matter only)
leakAs.description: Leak sensor is the proper type. If Apple Home does not show it, use contact sensor, where a leak shows as open.

fridgeTemperature.title: Fridge and freezer temperature (Matter only)
fridgeTemperature.description: Thermostat lets you set the temperature from Apple Home. Sensor is read only, a fallback if the thermostat does not work in Apple Home.

ignoreDevices.title: Ignore devices
ignoreDevices.description: Labels of SmartThings devices to leave out of HomeKit.

tvs.title: TVs
tvs.description: Optional per TV settings, matched on the SmartThings device label.
